scope: Laguna S 2.1 Q4_K_M layer-1 D8 Q4 gate/up invariant T16 metadata-hoist diagnostic on gfx1151

design.change: load each column's FP16 T16 d/dmin base and metadata tile pointer once per K256 instead of once per K32

correctness.red: focused test initially failed because the diagnostic weight_meta_hoist selector did not exist
correctness.green: counts 0/7/18/33, K512, dual N128 candidate is BF16 byte-identical to production and passes the CPU quality gate
correctness.focused_command: HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=1 PYTHONPATH=. uv run pytest -q 'tests/test_gguf_q4_k_q8_1_selected_prefill.py::test_q4_k_t16_ds4_f32_mmq64x32_matches_cpu_quality_gate[1-True-True-True]'

leaf.protocol: actual layer-1 weights and natural pp512 routing; producer-row pack inclusive; four warmups; 31 counter-rotated samples; burst=5
leaf.sanity: candidate checksum, max_abs, and every BF16 output equal production

trace.isa_audit: base loads are guarded by the subblock-zero path; intended hoist survived compilation

decision: Reject and remove. The median regresses 0.027%, the mean improves only 0.082%, and resources are unchanged. Invariant d/dmin traffic is cache-resident and not the limiting expert path.
